items.name: music.generate
items.direction: Bundle (iframe) → Host RPC → app_media_facade.music_generate → quota hold → anna_media_jobs INSERT → fal queue (webhook + poller) → R2
items.summary: Submit an asynchronous text-to-music job (optionally with lyrics, an instrumental flag, a duration, an output format or a reference image). The host resolves the model, validates **every** field against that model's catalogue entry, **pre-charges** the estimated CU, persists an `anna_media_jobs` row (`kind:'music'`), submits to the fal queue and returns a `mjob_…` handle within ~1s. Nothing is downgraded silently: a feature the model cannot deliver is rejected with `MUSIC_FEATURE_UNSUPPORTED` and `data.alternatives`. Progress arrives as `media_job` SSE events; `music.getJob` is the authoritative state. Most apps should use `anna.music.generateAwait()`.

wire.auth: Handled by the host page — the bundle never sees the token. Transport (`POST /api/v1/anna-apps/runtime/rpc`, `X-Anna-App-Token`, envelope wrapping) is described once in the section overview; the equivalent HTTP endpoints under `/api/v1/copilot/app/...` accept an `app_session_token`.

items.signature:
anna.music.generate(args: {prompt: string, lyrics?: string, instrumental?: boolean, durationSec?: number, format?: 'mp3'|'wav', referenceImageUrl?: string, options?: Record<string, unknown>, model?: string, clientTag?: string, idempotencyKey?: string}, opts?: {timeoutMs?: number}) => Promise<{jobId: string, kind: 'music', state: 'queued', estimatedCostCU: number, deadlineAt: string, idempotentReplay: boolean}>

anna.music.generateAwait(args, {onProgress?, signal?, timeoutMs?}) => Promise<JobView & {result: {url, refreshUrl(): Promise<string>, …}}>

params.name: prompt
params.summary: Style / mood / instrumentation description. Trimmed; empty or shorter than the model's `capabilities.promptMinChars` (MiniMax: 10) or longer than `promptMaxChars` → `MUSIC_INVALID_REQUEST`. Forwarded verbatim to the provider — provider safety filters apply (`MUSIC_CONTENT_REJECTED`, not billed).

params.name: lyrics
params.summary: Song lyrics. Only accepted when `capabilities.lyrics` is true (`lyricsMode:'field'` — MiniMax, ACE-Step — takes a dedicated field; `'prompt_embedded'` — Lyria, ElevenLabs — folds them into the prompt). Longer than `lyricsMaxChars` → `MUSIC_LYRICS_TOO_LONG`; on a model without lyrics → `MUSIC_FEATURE_UNSUPPORTED {feature:'lyrics'}`. MiniMax requires lyrics for vocal output unless `options.lyricsOptimizer` is on.

params.name: instrumental
params.summary: `true` asks for no vocals. `false` on an instrumental-only model (Stable Audio) → `MUSIC_FEATURE_UNSUPPORTED {feature:'vocals'}`.

params.name: durationSec
params.summary: Only for range-length models (`capabilities.duration.type:'range'` — ElevenLabs 3–600, Stable Audio 1–190, ACE-Step 5–240). Fixed-length models (MiniMax, Lyria) decide the length themselves and **reject** this field with `MUSIC_FEATURE_UNSUPPORTED {feature:'duration'}`.

params.name: referenceImageUrl
params.summary: An `https` image that steers mood / cover art (Lyria 3 only — `capabilities.referenceImage`). SSRF guard applies; other models → `MUSIC_FEATURE_UNSUPPORTED {feature:'referenceImage'}`.

params.name: options
params.summary: Model-native knobs declared in `capabilities.options` (schema v2: `seed`, `lyricsOptimizer`, …). camelCase keys are mapped to the provider's snake_case. Unlike `audio.speak`, **unknown keys are rejected** (`MUSIC_INVALID_REQUEST`) rather than dropped.

params.name: model
params.summary: Optional model hint (`modelName` from `llm.catalog({serviceType:'music_gen'})`). Defaults to the user's `modelPreferences.music_gen`, then the platform default (MiniMax Music 2.6). Unknown / inactive → `MUSIC_MODEL_UNAVAILABLE`.

params.name: clientTag
params.summary: Free-form correlation tag (≤120 chars) echoed in `getJob` / `listJobs` / `media_job`; filter `listJobs` by it.

params.name: idempotencyKey
params.summary: ≤64 chars `[A-Za-z0-9_\-:.]`. A second `generate` with the same key within **24 h** (same user + App) returns the existing job with `idempotentReplay:true` and **no new charge** — use it for retry-safe UI buttons and reload recovery.

returns.type: { jobId: string, kind: 'music', state: 'queued', estimatedCostCU: number, deadlineAt: string, idempotentReplay: boolean }
returns.desc: `jobId` is the `mjob_…` handle for every other call (`vjob_…` are video jobs). `estimatedCostCU` is the amount **held** from the user's quota; settled or refunded at the terminal state. `deadlineAt` is the server-side wall clock after which the job is failed and refunded. On an idempotent hit the full `JobView` of the earlier job is returned with `idempotentReplay:true`.

errors.name: APP_NOT_GRANTED
errors.desc: manifest `ui.host_api.music` does not list this method, or the user's `media_grant.music.enabled` is off for this App.

errors.name: APP_QUOTA_EXCEEDED
errors.desc: CU pre-charge failed — the user's plan quota is exhausted (HTTP 429 on the HTTP surface). There is no per-App concurrency or daily job cap; this is the only gate.

errors.name: MUSIC_INVALID_REQUEST
errors.desc: Malformed field (prompt empty / too short / too long, `durationSec` not an integer, bad `referenceImageUrl`, unknown `options` key, `clientTag` > 120 chars, bad `idempotencyKey`). `data.allowed` echoes the resolved model's parameter space.

errors.name: MUSIC_FEATURE_UNSUPPORTED
errors.desc: The resolved model cannot deliver a requested feature. `data = {feature:'lyrics'|'vocals'|'duration'|'format'|'referenceImage'|'stems'|'continuation', model, alternatives:[modelName…], allowed}` — pick one of `alternatives` or drop the feature. The host never downgrades silently.

errors.name: MUSIC_MODEL_UNAVAILABLE
errors.desc: No active text-to-music model is routable, or the `model` hint does not exist / is not allowed for the user.

errors.name: MUSIC_PROVIDER_ERROR
errors.desc: fal submit failed (message carries the first 200 chars of the provider error). The CU hold is refunded immediately.

errors.name: MUSIC_CONTENT_REJECTED
errors.desc: The provider's safety system rejected the prompt / lyrics / image (`data.stage:'provider'`). Not billed.

billing.model: pre-charge on submit → settle on `succeeded` → full refund on `failed` / cancelled-while-queued; cancelling a `running` job does not refund; an idempotent replay is never charged twice
billing.pricing: catalogue `pricing` by the provider's billing unit: `cuPerSong` (MiniMax, Lyria, Stable Audio), `cuPerSecond` (ACE-Step) or `cuPerMinute` with `roundUp` (ElevenLabs — rounded **up** to whole minutes). Shown in CU via `llm.catalog`.

limitations: Asynchronous only — `generateAwait` is SDK-side sugar (events + adaptive `getJob` polling).

No silent downgrade: a field the resolved model cannot honour fails with `MUSIC_FEATURE_UNSUPPORTED` — read `llm.catalog({serviceType:'music_gen'})` (`lyrics`, `lyricsMode`, `instrumentalOnly`, `duration`, `formats`, `referenceImage`) and build your form from it.
`stems`, `continuation` / `continueFrom` and `referenceAudioUrl` are reserved request fields — every current model rejects them with `MUSIC_FEATURE_UNSUPPORTED`.
Result URLs expire in ~30 min (`expiresIn`). Re-`getJob` to re-sign; for durable storage fetch the bytes and use `upload.negotiate`/`confirm`. Terminal objects are deleted after 7 days.
Generated music is licensed by the provider; `llm.catalog` entries may carry a `licenseNote` you should surface to the user before commercial use.
CSP: `media-src` must allow the host's R2 hostname (`https:`) to play `result.url` in an `<audio>` element.

items.name: music.getJob
items.direction: Bundle (iframe) → Host RPC → app_media_facade.music_get_job → anna_media_jobs (+ R2 presign)
items.summary: Authoritative job state. Returns the full `JobView`; on `succeeded`, `result.url` is a freshly presigned R2 GET — calling `getJob` again **re-signs** an expired URL. `media_job` events are an accelerator; this is the truth.

wire.auth: Handled by the host page — the bundle never sees the token. Transport (`POST /api/v1/anna-apps/runtime/rpc`, `X-Anna-App-Token`, envelope wrapping) is described once in the section overview; the equivalent HTTP endpoints under `/api/v1/copilot/app/...` accept an `app_session_token`.

items.signature:
anna.music.getJob({jobId: string}) => Promise<JobView>

JobView = {jobId, kind:'music', state:'queued'|'running'|'succeeded'|'failed'|'cancelled', clientTag?, idempotencyKey?, model, createdAt, updatedAt, deadlineAt, estimatedCostCU, request:{prompt, lyrics?, instrumental?, durationSec?, format?, referenceImageUrl?, options, model}, progress?:{seq, phase, queuePosition?}, result?:{url, mimeType, durationSec, lyrics?, seed?, expiresIn}, billedCostCU?, error?:{code, message}}

returns.desc: `result` is present only on `succeeded`: `url` (presigned, `expiresIn` seconds), `mimeType` (`audio/mpeg` | `audio/wav`), `durationSec` (measured from the file), `lyrics` when the provider returns the lyrics it actually sang, `seed` when the model exposes one. `billedCostCU` is the settled amount. On `failed` / `cancelled`, `error.code` is one of the `MUSIC_*` codes.

errors.name: APP_NOT_GRANTED
errors.desc: manifest `ui.host_api.music` does not list this method, or the user's `media_grant.music.enabled` is off for this App.

errors.name: MUSIC_JOB_NOT_FOUND
errors.desc: Unknown `jobId`, a `vjob_…` video handle, or a job owned by another user / App.

limitations: Rows are kept 30 days for billing; after the 7-day object cleanup `getJob` still answers but without `result.url`.
`result.durationSec` is measured from the delivered file (mp3 / wav header), so it may differ by a second from the requested `durationSec`.

items.name: music.cancelJob
items.direction: Bundle (iframe) → Host RPC → app_media_facade.music_cancel_job → fal queue cancel → quota refund
items.summary: Cancel a job. `queued` jobs are cancelled with a **full refund**; `running` jobs attempt a provider cancel — if the provider is already rendering the job stays `running` and nothing is refunded. Terminal jobs → `MUSIC_JOB_NOT_CANCELLABLE`.

wire.auth: Handled by the host page — the bundle never sees the token. Transport (`POST /api/v1/anna-apps/runtime/rpc`, `X-Anna-App-Token`, envelope wrapping) is described once in the section overview; the equivalent HTTP endpoints under `/api/v1/copilot/app/...` accept an `app_session_token`.

items.signature: anna.music.cancelJob({jobId: string}) => Promise<{jobId: string, state: 'cancelled', refunded: true} | {jobId: string, state: 'running', cancelPending: false}>

returns.type: { jobId, state: 'cancelled', refunded: true } | { jobId, state: 'running', cancelPending: false }
returns.desc: `{state:'cancelled', refunded:true}` when the hold was released; `{state:'running', cancelPending:false}` when the provider refused to cancel — the job will still reach a terminal state and be billed.

errors.name: APP_NOT_GRANTED
errors.desc: manifest `ui.host_api.music` does not list this method, or the user's `media_grant.music.enabled` is off for this App.

errors.name: MUSIC_JOB_NOT_FOUND
errors.desc: Unknown `jobId`, a `vjob_…` video handle, or a job owned by another user / App.

billing.model: full refund of the hold when cancelled while `queued`; no refund once the provider is rendering

limitations: Provider cancellation is best-effort; treat `cancelPending:false` on a `running` job as 'will complete and be billed'.

items.name: music.listJobs
items.summary: Cursor-paginated job history for this App (music jobs only — video jobs live under `video.listJobs`). Use it for reload recovery and to correlate jobs with your own entities via `clientTag`.

wire.auth: Handled by the host page — the bundle never sees the token. Transport (`POST /api/v1/anna-apps/runtime/rpc`, `X-Anna-App-Token`, envelope wrapping) is described once in the section overview; the equivalent HTTP endpoints under `/api/v1/copilot/app/...` accept an `app_session_token`.

items.signature: anna.music.listJobs({state?: string, clientTag?: string, limit?: number, cursor?: string}) => Promise<{jobs: JobView[], nextCursor?: string}>

params.name: clientTag
params.summary: Exact match on the tag set at `generate`.

returns.desc: Newest first. Each entry is the same view as `getJob` (URLs re-signed).

errors.name: APP_NOT_GRANTED
errors.desc: manifest `ui.host_api.music` does not list this method, or the user's `media_grant.music.enabled` is off for this App.

items.example:
const { jobs } = await anna.music.listJobs({ state: 'running' });
for (const j of jobs) resumeTracking(j.jobId, j.clientTag);
limitations: Scoped to the calling App and user — jobs created by other Apps (or via the Executa reverse RPC) are not listed.
